Hi Priya — great speaking with you earlier. Recap and proposed next steps below so we have a single source of truth.

Recap from call:
- Scope: RTBF for the list of user IDs you attached (we received FinTechCo-Deletion-Request-20260316.json)
- Goals: remove PII and derived artifacts from our systems and confirm timeline and evidence of purge

Proposed Redwood workflow & timelines (engineer/ops notes inlined):
1) Identification & verification (0–24 hrs): Confirm account identifiers and signed request (we have the JSON you attached; please confirm the canonical account_id mapping).
2) Live production purge (24–48 hrs): Remove PII and mark accounts deleted in primary DBs, clear KV/prefix caches and remove from session stores.
3) Indexes & embeddings (3–7 days): Re-run index/embedding prune or rebuild to remove derived vectors and search hits. Depending on index size, this can be batched; we will provide evidence links once complete.
4) Logs & telemetry (7–30 days): Application logs and telemetry are retained for troubleshooting; PII in logs is redacted where possible, but structured logs with user IDs will be scrubbed according to our retention pipeline.
5) Backups & snapshots (30–90 days): Backups (volume snapshots and long-term object storage) are subject to provider snapshot schedules and retention windows. We can initiate a purge request, but final physical deletion timing depends on snapshot immutability and retention holds — we will aim for earliest practical purge (target 30 days) and escalate for faster removal if contractually required.

What we need from FinTechCo to start:
- Confirm canonical account IDs that match our internal keys
- Signed RTBF request (we have the JSON stub; please confirm signature and signatory)
- Confirm if any legal holds exist for the affected accounts

Action items / owners:
- Camila: Coordinate kickoff and provide RTBF_Process_Summary.pdf (attached).
- Dylan: Technical execution plan and ETA for embeddings/index purge.
- Marissa: Contract/procurement check (expedite options for dedicated runs if needed).

I attached a short process summary (RTBF_Process_Summary.pdf) that outlines evidence we will provide at each stage. Dylan — I’m looping you in to confirm the technical constraints below.

Best,
Camila Reyes

camila@redwood.ai

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: RTBF / account deletion request — technical notes

Camila / Priya — adding the technical runbook and constraints so expectations are aligned. High-level notes: 

- DBs & caches: We have a synchronous job that marks the account deleted and removes PII fields from primary Postgres (or Dynamo) records; sessions and local caches are evicted within minutes. Physical row deletion is handled by an async compaction job to avoid load spikes.
- Embeddings & search: Embeddings are stored in object-store-backed vector indices. We have two approaches: (1) incremental prune of vectors by ID (preferred if ID mapping exists) — typically completed within 3–7 days; (2) reindexing which can be longer for large collections. We will choose incremental prune for the provided IDs.
- Logs & telemetry: Our pipeline retains unstructured logs for 90 days by default. We run a redaction job for PII when requested, but full removal from archived logs may take up to 30 days depending on aggregation windows.
- Backups / snapshots: Snapshot lifecycles are managed by the infra team and the cloud provider. For recent snapshots we can request expedited purge, but immutable snapshots (e.g., offsite WORM or archived backups) may require additional approval and could take up to 90 days. If FinTechCo requires faster physical deletion we will need an explicit contractual clause or a dedicated job run under their reserved capacity.
- Evidence & audit: We will provide an audit package with: (a) deletion job IDs and timestamps, (b) index prune logs with vector IDs removed, (c) snapshot purge request IDs and expected completion windows.

Requirements from FinTechCo to proceed:
- Canonical account_id mapping to our internal key (field: external_id -> account_id)
- Signed RTBF request and designated point-of-contact for legal questions

Proposed internal timeline (subject to verification):
- Start: within 24 hrs of signed request
- Production purge: 24–48 hrs
- Index prune / embeddings: 3–7 days
- Logs redaction: up to 30 days
- Backup purge: 30–60 days (90 days worst case for archived immutable backups)

I attached the JSON template that Camila referenced — it contains the fields we need for the job. Camila / Marissa: happy to sync on the exact runbook and be on the follow-up call.

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer | Redwood Inference
